hantuTanoshii.name: Han tu Tanoshii (personal Vietnamese-authored PDF, NOT an open/licensed dataset)
hantuTanoshii.url: n/a -- user-supplied PDFs, transcribed by hand/OCR into scripts/data/hantu-tanoshii-vocab/*.json for personal use only
hantuTanoshii.usedFor: word, reading, meaning, mnemonic, example sentence, and JLPT-appearance history, all as authored in the source PDFs
hantuTanoshii.license: Unknown/unverified copyright status -- transcribed and used at the user's own instruction for personal, non-published use only. Do NOT redistribute or publish this dataset/derivative extension while populated from this source without separately clearing rights.

notes: Transcribed from the Tanoshii "Tu vung N3 tung ra trong JLPT (2010-2024)" PDF, one row per word per exam sitting it was newly listed under.

occurrences lists every exam sitting (year/month) the source PDF noted that word as having appeared in, as of the PDF's own compilation -- not independently verified against official JLPT past papers.
readingOrSynonym holds whichever the source column gave for that row -- a kana reading, or a same-meaning synonym word -- the source PDF does not distinguish the two.
